svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 660 long from 40 bar; chamfer both ends 1 x 45 with a file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark from the rear end: rear bush at 40, chain 1 sprocket at 185,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front bush at 330, chain 2 sprocket at 480, torque tube bush 495 to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6 mm cross holes for the roll pins through each sprocket hub

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the sprocket on the bar (drill through hub and bar together).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Polish the bush and plug lengths with fine emery; no ridges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: turns in two flanged bushes in the tower; carries the arm frame

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the pivot tube plug on its front end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: turns freely by hand in both bushes with the tower bolted.
